findings.title: "roughly ten imported launchd user agents" undercounts and omits a real agent
findings.problem: The flake imports more launchd-agent-bearing modules than the ten enumerated (deepseek-v4-server.nix declares 7 agents, open-webui-tools.nix declares 2, basert/launch-agent.nix declares life.celestium.basert) and the list omits the imported omniroute-wireguard.nix. The design hedges with 'roughly' and the two cited shape-precedents (omniroute.nix, mlx-server.nix) are correct, so soundness is unaffected.
findings.fix: Change to 'a dozen-plus launchd user agents across the imported modules/darwin/*.nix' and drop the exact count, or label the list as representative, not exhaustive.

findings.title: agent Label naming scheme is dominant but not universal
findings.problem: com.celes.* is used by most agents, but basert uses life.celestium.basert. The proposed com.celes.toolhive-mcp matches the dominant scheme and is fine.
findings.fix: No change required; keep com.celes.toolhive-mcp (already chosen).

findings.title: thv client register omission must actually be carried into the ported start script
findings.problem: The reference toolhive.nix lines 83-84 do call thv client register kiro / vscode. The decision to omit them is correct for this flake, but the implementer must delete those two lines when adapting the start script since they exist in the source.
findings.fix: The ported start script must contain ONLY: PATH setup, defensive mkdir -p ai/logs, docker info wait loop, run_if_needed(), guarded secret reads (none for searxng), one run_if_needed searxng-enhanced with the exact reference flags, and exit 0. No thv client register lines.
